top_signals.title: Wheat Edges Lower on Peace Hopes as Black Sea Attacks Continue
top_signals.summary: Chicago wheat edged lower after the steepest drop in nearly three years even as prospects of a peace deal between Russia and Ukraine faded with continued fighting in the Black Sea region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chip Suppliers Bullish on AI Buildout
top_signals.summary: Chip suppliers at the annual SEMICON Taiwan event are bullish about the prospect of a continued AI buildout. Bloomberg's Chief North Asia Correspondent Stephen Engle reports from Taipei and explains how some firms are predicting the sector's current "super cycle" will last until 2030. (Source: Bloomberg)
